text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the Fan Appreciation Festival,
all sorts of competitions were being planned, but—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Please take a look at this poster.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to enter this "Softball Pitching Contest"
where you throw a softball.
choice_data_list: Pitching? Were you interested in that?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, nothing in particular.
However, I want to enter no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In this sport, where they apparently compete for
the "highest speed" with a pitch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Top speed." Those words must have
strongly drawn Calstone Light O in.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer, please be my partner.
I'll pitch with everything I've got to warm up...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Practice piled upon practice—
And finally, the day of the Fan Appreciation Festival arrived.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It is my turn, then. Here goes.
I have no experience in baseball or softball clubs,
but I will surely seize victory—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You've... never been in a club?
Not even on a local team or anything?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Winning like that is a bit of a stretch... Without enough pitching practice, throwing fastballs is out of the question...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SMACK!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh... You've gotta be kidding me...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A blazing fastball that even her baseball-loving older sister, Verxina, marvels at. And once everyone finished pitching—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: The winner is Calstone Light O!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: My top speed—is something I will never surrender.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Brushing aside numerous powerhouses, she clinched an easy victory.
Just when it seemed the contest was over—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Please give us an exhibition match!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-chan, I watched your pitches."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"And watching it got me all itching...
I just had to try taking a swing myself!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't hold this feeling back anymore!
My sports-loving blood is pumping!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan...
Understood—I accept your challenge.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the Mejiro family's powerhouse Umamusume,
Mejiro Ryan throws down the gauntlet!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
A showdown! A head-to-head showdown!
Batter: Mejiro Ryan.
Pitcher: Calstone Light O.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"The showdown is just one at-bat. If she gets a hit,
Mejiro Ryan wins. If she gets an out,
Calstone Light O wins."

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Well then, please throw your pitch.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the special sideshow match began.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: First pitch coming up!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Striiike!
Mejiro Ryan doesn't move a muscle.
She couldn't even make a move!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like you couldn't react in time.
Well then, let's keep going like this—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two strikes in the blink of an eye.
It seemed like the match was already decided.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see. She certainly is fast.
However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The spin is clean and easy to read.
I've seen the trajectory of the ball, too. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll get a hit. Absolutely.
Light O-chan, remember this fact.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That no pitcher can keep winning on fastballs alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It didn't sound like Mejiro Ryan was just putting on a brave face.
If so, then next time for sure...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: My top speed—will not be beaten.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If I'm the fastest, then absolutely.
—Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Calstone Light O threw the decisive pitch! The result was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CLANG!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not a parabolic arc... but a line drive like a bullet
flew right over Calstone Light O's head.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ah... Ah...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
How could this happen...
Urgh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O gave it her all and was defeated.
Yet, that too is the nature of competition...
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it, I was hoping to get a strikeout though...
Don't worry about it. You really wanted that strikeout, huh...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Strike three... Indeed.
However, far more than that!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That hit! It was so fast! Faster than my pitch!
Kuh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right. Calstone Light O was the type
to care more about sheer speed than winning or losing."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ryan-san, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Please teach me how to bat.
I want to surpass your speed—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In every genre and across every pattern,
Calstone Light O continued
her relentless pursuit of maximum speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: If I do what I've always done—I'll get hit.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: In that case, what should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is Light O
actually in a bit of a pinch?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I really hope they can keep it under control.
Winning at top speed is the dream, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Go, Right O!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Show us your dream!
Just like in a race...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ha, a dream... That's right...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I cannot lose when it comes to top speed.
I refuse to lose.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If I do what I've always done, I'll get hit.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I will surpass it. All I have to do is surpass it. Surpass who I've been until now, and go even further!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The air shifted. Energy swirled around
Calstone Light O. And then—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O pitches!
Mejiro Ryan swings with all her might!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Striiike!
Batter out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with a super fastball even faster than before,
Mejiro Ryan's bat swung through empty air.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It came out... I managed to pull it off...
In a tight corner like this..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A top speed surpassing everything before!
Aaaah, I...!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!!
Amazing, you're amazing, Ry-O!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
You're the true Fastball King!
Thanks for showing us the dream!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Light O-chan.
It's my complete defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No matter the fastball, as long as you get
the timing down, you can hit it. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I could hit a ball with speed I've never seen before.
It was amazing, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-san...
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I did it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"The ball was thrown faster than anyone else's.
Then next—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I want to surpass the speed of the balls I throw
with these very legs!
choice_data_list: ...Isn't that asking a bit too much!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how much he mastered it, Calstone Light O's
dream of reaching top speed never ceased."
